title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: order horizon of a straight-tip catheter liability notice on Original Medicare
content:
For a straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) liability notice on the Continence Original Medicare Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program, the order horizon is the number of whole 30-day blocks left on the newest written order. They are counted from a start date to that order's valid-through date. The start date depends on where the previous refill's supply stands.

## Rule

- **Slow delivery of the previous refill.** When the proof of delivery for the previous refill shows a delivery date more than 2 calendar days after its ship date, the order horizon is counted instead from that delivery date plus the previous refill's supply days. It is counted from the signing date instead when that date is already past.
- **Supply still running.** Otherwise, when the previous refill's ship date plus its supply days falls after the signing date, the order horizon is counted instead from that date.
- **Otherwise** it stays counted from the signing date.

The newest written order is the straight-tip order with the latest order date, and the previous refill is the program's straight-tip refill with the latest ship date.

## Cases (hypothetical: signing on day 0, newest order valid through day 365, previous refill of 90 supply days)

| Previous refill shipped | Its proof of delivery | Start of the count | Order horizon |
|---|---|---|---|
| day minus 60 | delivered day minus 59 | day 30, its ship date plus 90 | 335 days, so 11 whole blocks |
| day minus 60 | delivered day minus 50, which is 10 days after shipping | day 40, the delivery date plus 90 | 325 days, so 10 whole blocks |
| day minus 120 | delivered day minus 119 | day 0: the supply end of day minus 30 is past | 365 days, so 12 whole blocks |
| day minus 120 | delivered day minus 100 | day 0: the delivery date plus 90 is day minus 10, already past | 12 whole blocks |
